name: Goods Triple Match 3D 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Begin a satisfying match-3 puzzle challenge in Goods Triple Match 3D, a colorful and addictive casual logic game where all items appear in beautiful and realistic 3D.Your table is filled with many cute 3D drinks, and your goal is simple: find and match three identical objects.
